description: A native Go service with dev.liveReload through a real flisk up (moved from scripts/e2e/go-dev-loop.sh, #1298, #369): an ordinary edit is served without an image rebuild, a broken edit keeps the last good build serving with its compiler error in Tilt's log, and the next valid edit recovers. The go value of the language axis. One case, because the probe runs the whole edit sequence against one project.
checkName: Go live reload through flisk up and Traefik
